# Abandoned Cabin

Type: Structure | Internal ID: AbandonedLogCabin02 | AbandonedLogCabin03AbandonedLogCabin04 | Location: Mountains | Inhabitants: Skeleton, ,, Stone Golem

# Introduction

Abandoned Cabins are Points of interest found in the Mountain biome. They are dilapidated buildings made mostly of Log structures.

## Resources

They come in three variants. Each have a chance for the following feature:
• A chance for a Mountain Chest, notably containing Onion seeds and Valuables.
• A chance for Stone Golems to spawn once.
• A chance for Skeletons to spawn once.

• Id: AbandonedLogCabin02 | Resources: A 54.6% chance for a chest Up to 2 Stone Golems, with a 10% chance each

• Id: AbandonedLogCabin03 | Resources: Always has a chest A 10% chance for a Stone Golem Up to 2 Skeletons, with 50% chance each

• Id: AbandonedLogCabin04 | Resources: Always has a chest Up to 2 Stone Golems, with a 10% chance each Up to 2 Skeletons, with 50% chance each

Categorias: Points of interest
